name: Communicating With One Another
overview: Scripture teaches that communication among believers should be marked by truth, grace, and wisdom, reflecting the condition of the heart from which words proceed. A gentle response can defuse anger, while hasty or unhearing answers bring folly and shame. Believers are called to avoid lying and corrupt speech, instead speaking what builds others up and ministers grace, always seasoning their words with grace so they may respond appropriately to every person.
